text: FAA guidance emphasizes reestablishing the control link and, if unavailable, initiating emergency/contingency procedures, with a mandate that the remote PIC can change routing or altitude during automated flight. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual claims: if horizontal distance ≤ 10 m, return at current altitude; if 10–25 m, ascend to 20 m before returning (if already below 20 m). Incident reports provide no usable evidence from the approved collection.
